caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: This pie chart displays the distribution of quantifiers and operations across four reasoning types: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning. The chart is composed of twelve slices representing different categories within these reasoning types. In the “Categorical” section, slices are labeled “Existential Quantifiers” (light green, 15.12%), “Limiter” (light orange, 27.91%), “Negation” (light brown, 27.91%), and “Universal Quantifiers” (light blue, 29.07%). The “Approximate Number Generation” section shows “Absolute Absence” (light purple, 18.71%), “Approximate Quantities” (light gray, 45.03%), and “Comparative Relationships” (blue, 36.26%). Finally, “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” presents “Disjunctive” (light pink, 49.51%) and “Conjunctive” (pink, 50.49%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order by proportion within each section. A legend is not present, but each slice is explicitly labeled.
